decisions.reason: This low-cost burner component supports the core radiant-heater range, and nothing in the evidence shows its value has failed to materialize, so keeping the option open remains cheap.
The firm presents this electric infrared panel line as a flagship of its electrification direction, and after two years its uncertain upside is still worth preserving at modest cost.
The halogen heater adds little cost within a broad infrared portfolio, and the limited evidence so far does not show its value to be unrealizable, though it is the most expendable option.
This multi-model industrial electric hall heater sits close to core customers and benefits from rising demand for electrified heating, so continuing the option is justified.

The hydrogen-capable dark infrared series is a strategic flagship with documented real-world operation, and it preserves a valuable growth option in low-carbon heating while hydrogen uncertainty resolves.
